newsitem.title: UK: April Brent loadings down at 35 cargoes plus topup.
newsitem.headline: April Brent loadings down at 35 cargoes plus topup.

text.p: The April North Sea Brent Blend crude oil loading programme has been set at 35 full cargoes plus 1.4 million barrels in top-ups, traders said on Thursday.
The April programme was the equivalent of eight full cargoes less than March, when 42 cargoes plus 1.93 million barrels were scheduled to load.
Traders said the lower programme was partly due to scheduled maintenance at three fields.

Shell Expro's 55,000-barrels per day (bpd) Brent Delta platform is due to shut on April 1 as part of a long-term refurbishment programme, while Chevron's 50,000 bpd Ninian field is due to close from April 18 to May 5.
Texaco's 40,000 bpd Strathspey field is also scheduled to close for 12 days in April.
Crude from the Brent and Ninian systems is blended at Sullom Voe terminal on the Shetland Islands and exported as world benchmark Brent Blend.
Shell Exploration and Production (Shell Expro) is a joint venture between Royal Dutch/Shell Group and Exxon Corp.
